ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
name: icu
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "79.1"

package:
  name: icu
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/download/release-${{ version }}/icu4c-${{ version }}-sources.tgz
    sha256: 06fa63ecb521048f8082f12ad988f6b678d90cbd88aafce24cbc94902b191d99
    patches:
      - if: win
        then:
          # Include an extra header when using mingw.
          - icu4c-4_9_1-mingw-w64-mkdir-compatibility.patch
          # Omit lib prefix on libraries.
          - icu-config.patch
          # Avoid exporting Unix libm through pkg-config on Windows.
          - no-libm-pkgconfig-win.patch
      - if: osx
        then: mach-port-t.patch
  - url: https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/download/release-${{ version }}/icu4c-${{ version }}-data.zip
    sha256: b3a430009bb5fab77b1a4b98fab85cc8f887e26d4e4166121724298ae14d7224
    target_directory: icu-data-src

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: win
      then:
        - python 3.11.*
        - m2-base
        - m2-make
        - m2-sed
        - m2-coreutils
    - if: unix
      then:
        # Needed to generate data/rules.mk at configure time (ICU >= 78).
        - python
        - libtool
        - make
  host:
  run:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('icu') }}

tests:
  - script:
      # Extensionless: rattler-build appends .sh (Unix) or .bat (Windows).
      file: run_test
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - pkg-config
    files:
      recipe:
        - gb-18030-2000.ucm
        - de.txt
        - test.c

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: International Components for Unicode.
  homepage: https://icu.unicode.org
  repository: https://github.com/unicode-org/icu
  documentation: https://unicode-org.github.io/icu-docs/apidoc/released/icu4c/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ccordoba12
    - jakirkham
    - msarahan
    - ocefpaf
    - xhochy
